body.name: \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(\lambda)\)
body.construction:
\[
\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(\lambda)
=\left\{P_{N,T,(n_s)_{s=1}^{S}}:
P_{N,T,(n_s)_{s=1}^{S}}\text{ satisfies every member property listed below}\right\}.
\]
The member properties are \texttt{ass:consistency}, \texttt{ass:historical-consistency}, \texttt{ass:no-spillovers}, \texttt{ass:limited-anticipation}, \texttt{ass:historical-regression}, \texttt{ass:event-transport}, \texttt{ass:bounded-historical-wealth}, \texttt{ass:bounded-event-wealth}, \texttt{ass:holder-smoothness}, \texttt{ass:design-density}, \texttt{ass:interior-event-path}, \texttt{ass:cross-unit-independence}, \texttt{ass:temporal-mixing}, \texttt{ass:donor-independence}, \texttt{ass:donor-replication}, \texttt{ass:donor-ellipticity}, \texttt{ass:donor-fourth-moment}, \texttt{ass:exact-training-coordinates}, \texttt{ass:local-two-sided-modulus}, and \texttt{ass:positive-query-region}.  Writing \(D=Sd\), call \(B>D^2\) interior-compatible and \(B=D^2\) boundary-compatible.  Configurations \(B<D^2\) are incompatible and receive no substantive minimax interpretation.  These are fixed envelope-constant scope labels, not additional law-level member properties.
